_comment: Workspace MCP Server Configuration for NutriSync (numbers-dont-lie). Defines external context providers for live documentation (Context7), local read-only schema introspection (PostgreSQL), and repository workflow metadata (GitHub).

context7._comment: Fetches live, version-accurate documentation for Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, Zod v4, Go 1.26, GORM, FastAPI, and Pydantic v2 so the agent never relies on outdated training weights.

postgres-readonly._comment: Provides read-only SQL/schema introspection against the local Docker PostgreSQL database (port 5432, db: nutrisync). Used strictly to verify table names, column types, indexes, and foreign keys generated by GORM AutoMigrate. Never connect to production or use for write/DDL operations.

github._comment: Provides access to GitHub issues, pull request review comments, and CI/Actions workflow logs. Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in the host environment (never hardcode tokens here).
